claims.text: Scoring in the conference splits sharply between the top tier and the rest: UW-Superior's 47 goals alone exceed the combined output of Bethany Lutheran, North Central (Minn.), and Minnesota Morris.

claims.text: North Central (Minn.) has conceded 65 goals while scoring fourteen across three wins, one draw, and thirteen losses, allowing more goals than Bethany Lutheran and UW-Superior combined.
